# Munari

> HTML, 3D, and Shaders, Unified. Munari renders retained HTML in Three.js scenes, preserving the original DOM and state. It captures through Chrome's HTML-in-canvas capability where the browser has it and through snapDOM everywhere else; the README's engine table says what each one follows and what it draws.

The current public API is documented in the README and published types.
[Decision #43](https://github.com/petekp/munari/blob/v0.4.0/docs/decisions.md#43) records the retained-HTML API adoption.
Earlier decisions describe historical interfaces and must be read with their
later amendments.

## Start in the version you are using

- [README and package setup](README.md)
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)
- [Munari agent skill](.agents/skills/munari/SKILL.md)

In a checkout, confirm the repository, branch and dirty scope, then choose a
task route below. In an installed package, read its index.d.ts, advanced.d.ts
and snapdom.d.ts for exact APIs. The package ships the three files above, not
the full repository docs or registry. The links below point at the v0.4.0 tag
on GitHub. Do not substitute mutable main as version-local truth.

capability skip as untested behavior.
